title: ContextWell Lab Joins IASEAI as an Affiliate
excerpt: ContextWell Lab has joined the International Association for Safe & Ethical AI, connecting its work with a global community advancing responsible AI.

title: ContextWell Lab Launches New Research Initiative
excerpt: A new research programme explores how well-being can be embedded as infrastructure in educational systems across three continents.

title: White Paper Published: Well-Being as Embedded Infrastructure
excerpt: Our foundational white paper outlines well-being and human oversight as infrastructure for AI-mediated systems.

title: Healthcare Partners Join ContextWell Collaboration
excerpt: Healthcare collaborators are exploring capacity-building programmes that bring ContextWell research into clinical settings.

title: New Publication in PLOS ONE
excerpt: Our exploratory sequential mixed-methods study on AI for contextual well-being in medical education is now open access.
